title: "Unable to parse the value of parameter robot_description as yaml" in ROS 2 launch: ParameterValue, missing xacro, the TextSubstitution PATH error and xml.parsers, measured
excerpt: Why a xacro Command fails YAML parsing when the URDF has a colon or # comment, why passing URDFs get folded into one line, and what the TextSubstitution not found on the PATH, executed command failed and xml.parsers errors mean. Measured on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical.
